task.title: [M5] Canonical deterministic builds, export gates and provenance
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M5
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M5-03
**Implementation status:** Implemented and independently QA_PASS; acceptance synchronized after reviewer retest. Kaneo column is authoritative.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex (`aM3as9DCoQ7pMoO3V9XsDbL3q2j9pWjn`), verified account. Independent reviewer is separate and retains read-only scope.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§2.3, 4.3–4.6, 6/M5, 8, 12
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Publish repeatable builds from approved canonical inputs without false production labels.

**Scope:** Canonical ordering/numerics/encoders, build identity/manifest, cache, atomic publication and production/diagnostic gates.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Same source/contract/profile/composition/toolchain/output policy in two clean builds at different paths/times yields identical SPR/ACT SHA-256 hashes.
- [x] Specify schema/action/view/frame/layer/image ordering and numeric rounding/field encodings; pin decoder/resampler/palette/color-space/encoder versions. Never reorder semantically ordered layers.
- [x] Build identity excludes timestamps, hostname, absolute paths, random UUIDs, filesystem traversal order and native-test data; linked verification evidence remains outside deterministic artifact inputs.
- [x] Production export rejects underspecified/missing/invalid/stale or unapproved required assignments; partial diagnostic exports are conspicuously PARTIAL_DIAGNOSTIC with scoped/full states separate.
- [x] Manifest includes source/target/profile/policy/tool hashes, approved pre-build composition digest, output hashes and preservation/conversion policy; atomic cache/publication cannot mutate originals or publish partial production output.

## Verification

Two-clean-build hash equality, ordering/rounding regressions, interrupted publication, fail-closed export and changed-one-source affected-approval checks.

Actual commands, environment, exits, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN limits are recorded in docs/verification/rsf-25/VERIFICATION.md. No artwork approval or native run is claimed.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-24 (M5-02; task ID nw62kniena0oeqe44yba8uil)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Build/native evidence never creates aesthetic approval.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence

- Changed: core/build.py (new), core/compiler.py, cli.py, compilation-manifest-v1.json, project-v1.json, README.md; tests/test_canonical_builds.py (new). Bounded diff and file hashes: docs/verification/rsf-25/implementation.diff and implementation-manifest.json.
- Evidence manifest SHA-256: 0bb46f2dbffed272c1ba7ed62469bca8dd2ef8c231d17798c6a6ad59ef00e77f.
- Focused 14 PASS; public 445 PASS; private 37 PASS/1 existing native-report skip; independent Rust 11 PASS; 10 schema checkers PASS; installed distribution 441 PASS/4 optional skips, reproducible wheels/private exclusions PASS. Commands/exits in VERIFICATION.md.
- Two clean builds at different paths: ACT/SPR/canonical manifest bytes equal. ACT 120ab61c15f4de8658baa6aaabe5f860262e05f6b4f188e5b4378c9eacba3bea; SPR 2706d9c70e260db35c87d11097d6a718c197989e26db918726c3f0b6a886bad9. build-manifest SHA256 226129845c393d8899ea031c9e08f9e6b31efb534fb8fbf7a05f7fb7d2b0ebce.
- M5-S PASS; M5-I PASS within task scope; M5-N UNVERIFIED. Python 3.12/3.13 NOT_RUN unavailable; Chromium NOT_RUN no UI changes. No commits/pushes; accepted codec/Rust source and private originals preserved. M5 remains open.

## Independent QA result

QA_PASS from separate repository-configured forge_qa_reviewer context /root/rsf24_qa. All five live criteria passed; no mandatory finding remains. Reviewer did not edit files, write Kaneo or take ownership.

Initial QA_FAIL (QA_INITIAL.md): explicit/per_frame topology could reuse source-layer approval while preserved ACT placement/timing changed. Corrected by UNBOUND_PRODUCTION_COMPOSITION rejection for role-only topology; resource-bound inherited production remains supported; explicit bounded diagnostics remain supported. Reviewer independently reran original reproduction, confirmed original/changed ACT production rejection with no output, false production plans, labeled diagnostic publication, and valid inherited production publication.

Independent commands: corrected focused14 PASS exit0; pre-correction full public444 PASS exit0; private37 PASS/1 existing native-report skip exit0; Rust11 PASS exit0; all10 schema checkers PASS exit0; final source/evidence hash verification PASS. Final coordinator full public445, private37+1skip, installed441+4optional skips inspected by reviewer (not misrepresented as independent reruns).

Durable final verdict: docs/verification/rsf-25/QA_REVIEW.md SHA256 0e2868bddcb9b197380d191155b9122de6a4c32cee0f01274dc68cfebc69dee4. Reviewed implementation manifest SHA256 0bb46f2dbffed272c1ba7ed62469bca8dd2ef8c231d17798c6a6ad59ef00e77f. M5-S PASS for this task; M5-I PASS within oracle scope; M5-N UNVERIFIED. M5 remains open, no native/artwork approval implied.
